title: FEARFILES #3: TRAIL CAM

lines.text: Never check your trail cam after night three.
lines.say: Never check your trail cam after night three.

lines.text: I set it up to catch whatever ate my garden.
Night one: a deer. Night two: a deer.
Night three: something standing. On two legs.
Night four, it was closer. Night five, closer.
Every photo was taken at 3:12 AM.
lines.say: Every photo was taken at three twelve A.M.

lines.text: At dawn, I went to take the camera down.
It was gone. The strap was cut clean.
That night, my phone buzzed. A new photo.
My bedroom. Taken from inside my closet.
Me, asleep. The date on it was tomorrow.

lines.say: I looked at my clock. Three eleven.

lines.text: And my closet door just opened. One inch.
So never check your trail cam after night three.
